crossRefs.note: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.
The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
“Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the…
and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land…
Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bathrabbim. Your nose is like…
Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer…
“Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near…
Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.

parallels.note: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.
For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice…
Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and…

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Jazer
people.line: A town in Gilead, allotted to Gad

translations.web: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.
translations.bsb: Heshbon, and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.
translations.kjv: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
